chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'No two people travel together except that the one with the greater reward and the one most beloved to Allah, Exalted and Majestic, is the one who is most kind/gentle to his companion.'

key_terms.أَحَبُّهُمَا إِلَى اللَّهِ: the one most beloved to Allah
key_terms.أَعْظَمُهُمَا أَجْراً: the one with the greatest reward
key_terms.اصْطَحَبَ: to accompany each other on a journey

ai.seo_question: Who receives the greatest reward when two people travel together?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) highlights the spiritual merit of travel companionship, linking social kindness directly to divine favor. It establishes a hierarchy of reward based on mutual gentleness, reinforcing the Shia emphasis on adab (etiquette) and ihsan (excellence) in interpersonal relationships as a means of attaining closeness to Allah.
